claimStatus.theta: one local actual-theta interval witness certified

theoremConditions.linePinning: Reflection symmetry plus one zero counting multiplicity in a reflection-symmetric disk
theoremConditions.branchAssignment: Continuous pairwise-disjoint disks with zero-free boundaries
theoremConditions.movingStep: integral sup_|w|=1 |tauPrime*Fss/4+(centerPrime+radiusPrime*w)*Fs| d(lambda) < initial boundary modulus floor
theoremConditions.scope: Uniform bounds over full parameter intervals and full disk boundaries are required; finite samples are insufficient

exactQuarticCertificate.claim: Four disjoint moving disks each contain exactly one simple zero for every tau in [-13/100,0].
exactQuarticCertificate.proofKind: Exact rational Bernstein bounds and Taylor–Rouche on every full time cell and full complex disk
exactQuarticCertificate.arithmetic: Python arbitrary-size integers and fractions.Fraction; no floating-point decisions
exactQuarticCertificate.centerInterpolation: piecewise affine in tau; centerStart at tauMin, centerEnd at tauMax
exactQuarticCertificate.displayScope: Numeric fields are rounded displays of the rational strings. Certification applies to the recorded affine centers and radius, not arbitrary root-centered or resized disks.
exactQuarticCertificate.coverage: All four polynomial zeros, since the four disjoint disks each have count one and P has degree four.
exactQuarticCertificate.endpointScope: Stops at tau=-.13, before the exact collision tau=-(10-sqrt(46))/24. No extension through collision is claimed.

thetaCertifiedWitness.claim: The actual entire theta family has exactly one simple zero in this fixed reflection-symmetric disk for every real tau in [-1/20,1/20]; this zero lies on the critical line.
thetaCertifiedWitness.proof: Arb xi value/derivative bounds, a whole-disk xi second-derivative bound from 128 contour nodes plus a rigorous third-derivative moment, Taylor–Rouche for initial count one, and a rigorous whole-time theta perturbation bound. Explicit n and integration tails are included.
thetaCertifiedWitness.scope: One fixed disk around the first tracked zero. It does not certify the other tracked branches, resized or root-centered disks, all heights, or all tau. No RH conclusion is asserted.

method.rounding: Outward ball arithmetic; final claims are fixed rational constants
method.tailMethod: Positive-term envelope, geometric n tail, and decreasing log-derivative integration tail

thetaCandidateAudit.curvatureFormula: B=32 integral_0^infinity u^2 exp(.2 u^2) Phi(u) cosh(.02 u) du; valid for |tau|<=.2 and |Re(s)-1/2|<=.01
thetaCandidateAudit.scope: Tests the Taylor–Rouche inequality numerically at the saved centers only. Kernel truncation, quadrature, raw residuals and between-frame time values are not enclosed. Does not rule out other zeros.

inputProvenance.transformation: Retains all 723 frame times and all 2169 root records needed for channel audit; drops contour arrays and unrelated diagnostics.
